QuestInfo.name: Music Preparation
QuestInfo.0: Lana says she needs to pick out a song for Blake. Talk to #bLana#k for more details on what she needs.
QuestInfo.1: You have to find an awesome song for Blake to perform. Get a CD at the music store on the #r7th - 8th Floors of Kerning Square#k and take it to #bLana#k.
QuestInfo.2: Lana said the existing hits weren't good enough and asked you to get a new song from #bMaestro Rho#k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 7,700\nCan proceed to the Request for a New Song quest\n

0.0: It's time to pick out the music Blake is going to perform. First, we have to listen to a lot of popular hits. Could you bring me some CDs from Kerning Square?

yes.0: There's a great music store on the #r7th-8th Floors of Kerning Square#k. You could spend hours just browsing in there! Please bring me #b15 Latest Hits Compilation CDs and 15 Greatest Oldies CDs#k.

no.0: We can't have Blake perform without music. Obviously.

1.0: Did you bring the CDs? Hand them over. I have to listen to them.

yes.0: Hm, the latest hits are all right...but we can't captivate an audience with them. We need a brand new song, composed just for Blake. Ah, Maestro Rho would be perfect. He's a little arrogant, but he's a genius at composing. With his music, Blake will become a star in no time. We need a song from #bMaestro Rho#k.

item.0: Please bring me #b15 Latest Hits Compilation CDs and 15 Greatest Oldies CDs#k from the 7th-8th floor of Kerning Square.
